title: Location Record
description: A specific site you care about: an office, a store, a facility, a hand-drawn area of interest. Distinct from `place`, which is a named administrative area from the gazetteer - AIT Austin is a location, Travis County is a place. Nearly all of the original mdm.locations fields moved onto the envelope: kind -> category.primary, parent -> parent_id, the address fields -> geo.address under their original names, latitude/longitude -> geo.point as [lon, lat], code -> identifiers. The payload is correspondingly thin, which is the point.

geo.description: Required in practice: a location record without geography is just a label.

hours.description: OSM opening_hours syntax if you want it machine-readable, free text otherwise.

access_notes.description: Gate codes, dock instructions, badge requirements. Often warrants visibility=restricted on the whole record.
